CalendarAvailabilityTeam.description: A Team that can see the owner's availability while the switch is on.

CalendarAvailabilityCalendar.description: One of the owner's own personal event calendars or one of their Team event calendars. ICS subscriptions and calendars shared with the owner are never listed. A calendar without a stored choice is included and `busy`.

include.description: Whether the calendar counts toward the owner's availability.

detail.description: `busy`: teammates see the time only. `details`: also the title and location. Team calendars are always `busy`.

CalendarAvailabilitySettings.description: The caller's Team availability settings. While `enabled` is false nobody gets anything for the caller, the caller included; choices are kept and come back when it is turned on again.

enabled.description: Share my availability with my Teams. Off by default.

CalendarAvailabilitySettingsUpdate.description: Partial update. Omitted fields keep their value. Every `calendarId` must be one of the caller's own personal or Team event calendars, and `details` is only allowed on a personal calendar; otherwise 422 and nothing is written.

CalendarAvailabilityAccountCapability.description: Account-level object of the vendor capability `urn:wgw:jmap:availability` (the session-level value is the empty object). Limits of TeamMember/getAvailability; a larger request is `invalidArguments` before any read.

CalendarAvailabilityTeamMember.description: TeamMember (urn:wgw:jmap:availability): someone whose availability the caller may read. Listed only while their switch is on, they are not disabled, and they share at least one Team with the caller (the admin role gives no extra access); the caller is listed as themselves (`isSelf`) while their own switch is on.

id.description: The person's username, the same string as their JMAP accountId.

version.description: Changes when the person renames or changes their switch, which calendars count, or how much detail they share. A client drops every cached week of this person when it changes.

CalendarAvailabilityTeamMemberGetRequest.description: TeamMember/get arguments. `ids: null` returns everyone the caller may see.

CalendarAvailabilityTeamMemberGetRespons.description: TeamMember/get response. `state` is a hash of every visible (id, version); there is no TeamMember/changes. Unknown people, people with the switch off, disabled people and people who share no Team with the caller all come back in `notFound` alike.

CalendarAvailabilityBusyPeriod.description: One busy occurrence, close to the standard Principal/getAvailability BusyPeriod. Time fields are read like the same fields of a CalendarEvent: `start` is a UTC date-time with `Z` (timeZone null), a local date-time with an IANA `timeZone`, a floating local date-time (timeZone null), or a bare date when `showWithoutTime`. `title` and `location` appear only for an event on a personal calendar the owner shares with `details` that is not private or confidential; a location holding a URL is dropped and the title is cut at 200 characters.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H or P1D.

CalendarAvailabilityGetRequest.description: TeamMember/getAvailability arguments. The range is whole UTC weeks: `utcStart` a Monday 00:00:00Z and `utcEnd` a whole number of weeks later, at most 54 weeks, at most 50 ids, and ids × weeks at most 540. Anything else is `invalidArguments`.

excludeEventId.description: A CalendarEvent id. Every occurrence of that event's UID is left out, so an invitee is not busy with the event being edited. It must be an event the caller may edit, or one the caller organizes or attends; any other id is `invalidArguments`.

complete.description: False when some busy time in the range could not be worked out (an unreadable event, a recurrence over the limit, or more than 2000 periods in a week). A gap is then not proof of free time.

CalendarAvailabilityGetResponse.description: TeamMember/getAvailability response. Periods are sorted by start and include every occurrence that overlaps the range, also ones that start before it.
